prompt.project_info: Candid 1990s Japanese street-photography film portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with hair flowing in a rim-lit breeze, standing with her back partly toward camera, head tilted back toward the sky and joyful smile; wearing a navy cropped jacket and navy mini skirt.
